collected.name: Total collected
collected.definition: Confirmed payments received in the period (each payment's amount, never counting installments or allocations twice). It is not profit: it does not deduct costs or expenses. Date used: payment date.

collected_cash.name: Collected in cash
collected_cash.definition: Part of the total collected that was received in cash. Date used: payment date.

collected_other.name: Collected by other methods
collected_other.definition: Part of the total collected by bank transfer, card or other methods. Date used: payment date.

pending_verification.name: Transfers pending verification
pending_verification.definition: Registered payments not yet confirmed; they do not count as collected. Date used: payment date.

issued.name: Obligations issued
issued.definition: Amount due on obligations issued in the period, excluding voided ones. It is what was billed to the member, not what was collected. Date used: issue date.

outstanding.name: Outstanding balance
outstanding.definition: What members owe today: amount due minus collected on open obligations. It is a snapshot of today; the system does not store past balances.

overdue.name: Overdue balance
overdue.definition: Part of the outstanding balance whose due date has passed.

reversed.name: Reversed payments
reversed.definition: Amount of payments reversed in the period; not included in the total collected. Date used: reversal date.

active_members.name: Active members
active_members.definition: Members with an active record and a valid, paid membership on the last day of the period.

new_members.name: New members
new_members.definition: Member records created in the period. Date used: sign-up date.

new_enrollments.name: New enrollments
new_enrollments.definition: Memberships sold in the period as a member's first contract. Date used: sale date.

renewals.name: Renewed memberships
renewals.definition: Memberships sold in the period as a renewal of another one. Date used: sale date.

reincorporations.name: Re-enrollments
reincorporations.definition: Memberships sold to members who had others before, not as a renewal.

expired.name: Expired memberships
expired.definition: Active memberships whose end date fell in the period and has passed (cancelled ones excluded). Date used: end date.

expiring_soon.name: Expiring soon
expiring_soon.definition: Active memberships ending within the chosen number of days. Snapshot of today.

gym_visits.name: Gym attendance
gym_visits.definition: Gym entries registered in the period. Date used: entry date and time.

sessions_held.name: Classes held
sessions_held.definition: Sessions closed as held. Past sessions nobody closed are reported separately as pending closure. Date used: session start.

sessions_cancelled.name: Classes cancelled
sessions_cancelled.definition: Sessions cancelled whose start fell in the period.

class_occupancy.name: Class occupancy
class_occupancy.definition: Confirmed bookings ÷ capacity of non-cancelled sessions (weighted). Waitlist, offered spots and cancelled bookings are not counted.

reservations_confirmed.name: Confirmed bookings
reservations_confirmed.definition: Confirmed bookings of the period's non-cancelled sessions.

reservations_cancelled.name: Cancelled bookings
reservations_cancelled.definition: Bookings cancelled by the member or staff (not those cancelled because the session was cancelled).

class_no_shows.name: Class no-shows
class_no_shows.definition: Confirmed bookings marked as "did not attend".

my_sessions_cancelled.name: My classes cancelled
my_sessions_cancelled.definition: Your sessions cancelled whose start fell in the period.

my_occupancy.name: Occupancy of my classes
my_occupancy.definition: Confirmed bookings ÷ capacity of your non-cancelled sessions.

my_no_shows.name: No-shows in my classes
my_no_shows.definition: Confirmed participants who did not attend your classes.

payments_count.name: Payments received
payments_count.definition: Number of confirmed payments in the period.

partial_amount.name: Partial payments (installments)
partial_amount.definition: Amount collected in allocations that cover only part of the obligation's amount due.

partial_count.name: Payments that are installments
partial_count.definition: Payments with at least one allocation that does not settle the obligation's amount due.

inactive_members.name: Inactive members
inactive_members.definition: Members whose record is marked inactive. Snapshot of today.

members_with_balance.name: Members with an outstanding balance
members_with_balance.definition: Members with an open obligation that is still owed. Snapshot of today.

losses.name: Losses
losses.definition: Members active the day before the period who no longer have a valid membership at its end. A cancelled membership is not a loss if the member has another valid one.

visits.name: Visits
visits.definition: Gym entries registered in the period.

unique_visitors.name: Members who attended
unique_visitors.definition: Distinct members with at least one entry in the period.

frequency.name: Attendance frequency
frequency.definition: Visits ÷ distinct members who attended (average visits per attendee).

occupancy_reserved.name: Booked occupancy
occupancy_reserved.definition: Confirmed bookings ÷ capacity of non-cancelled sessions (weighted). Waitlist, offered spots and cancelled bookings are not counted.

occupancy_attended.name: Attended occupancy
occupancy_attended.definition: Attendees ÷ capacity of held sessions with attendance recorded. Without records there is no figure.

waitlisted.name: Waitlist demand
waitlisted.definition: People on the waitlist or holding an offered spot (they wanted in but there was no room). It is not occupancy.

no_shows.name: No-shows
no_shows.definition: Confirmed bookings marked as "did not attend".

late_cancellations.name: Late cancellations
late_cancellations.definition: Bookings cancelled after the class cancellation deadline.

offers_expired.name: Expired offers
offers_expired.definition: Waitlist invitations that were not accepted in time.
